features.title: Measured first. Calculated carefully.
features.subtitle: Power telemetry without pretending every PC exposes whole-system draw.
items: The selected iCUE sensor is named and its measured scope stays explicit.
Wh and kWh use actual elapsed sample time with trapezoidal integration.
Disconnects, sleep and stale intervals are never filled with invented power.
See current watts beside time-weighted average, observed peak and accumulated energy.
